content.short: Tadle is a prompt-driven sandbox on Monad automating trading, lending and other onchain actions.
content.description: Tadle is a sandbox layer for accessing dapps, aimed at reshaping how projects run a token generation event and go to market. Its dMCP can call blockchain APIs under permissions the user sets, so tools act only within agreed limits. Traders use it to unlock liquidity, claim instant rewards and reach predictive markets in one place. Integrated protocols include Morpho, Curvance, Euler and other Monad lending and trading venues.
content.meta: Describe an onchain workflow in a prompt and test it before it runs with real funds.
